ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: A video can demonstrate a standard movement, but a teacher's observation and care determine whether a child is ready today and how to break the movement into achievable steps.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 41,000 special education professionals employed in 2024, rising to a projected 41,500 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 500 jobs and about 2,900 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $67,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace adapted physical education specialists, and exposure is relatively low. Movement libraries and video demonstrations can support instruction, but individualized assessment, safety support, and emotional encouragement depend heavily on human relationships. Teachers shift from demonstrating movements toward assessment, planning, and hands-on support, making combined education and rehabilitation expertise more resilient.
ai_s2_auto: Automated movement demonstrations from video libraries
ai_s3_list: Ability assessment: people observe the child's condition.
Breaking down activities: people set achievable steps.
Safety support: people protect children from hazards.
Emotional support: people provide encouragement.
Interdisciplinary coordination: people organize the pace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in the low-moderate AI exposure range for interpersonal work. Tools assist demonstrations and records, but people remain central to assessment and physical support.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure means limited displacement risk. Standard movement demonstrations can be replaced, but individualized support roles cannot. Caring teachers who understand rehabilitation and work one-on-one become more valuable as inclusive education expands.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in physical education or special education, and study rehabilitation and assistive devices while in school. Pure demonstration work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop assessment skills early.
Move beyond leading exercises toward assessment plus individualized planning. Learn rehabilitation concepts and work toward becoming a resource teacher.
Highlight individualized cases and specify the disability groups you have supported. Schools value steadiness and compassion.
Do not evaluate candidates only on athletic ability. Look for empathy. Resource teachers who can provide reliable support are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Inclusive education expands, bringing gradual demand growth.
Video and recordkeeping tools improve efficiency.
Teachers who combine education and rehabilitation expertise become scarcer.

body: Adapted physical education specialists design individualized physical activity programs for children with special needs, adapt equipment and rules, assess movement and participation, and build fitness and confidence through safe, supportive instruction.
career_ai_description_block.heading: A video can demonstrate a standard movement, but a teacher's observation and care determine whether a child is ready today and how to break the movement into achievable steps.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 视频能示范标准动作，但哪个孩子今天状态行不行、怎么拆步才够得着，还是老师的眼和心定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年专家教育在岗约 4.10 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.15 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.29 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.74 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代适应性体育专家，且曝光低。动作库与视频示范能辅助教学，但个别化评估、陪护安全和情绪支持高度人际，难被替代；老师从「示范」转向「评估+方案+陪护」，懂康复的复合人才更稳。
ai_s3_list: 能力评估：状态靠人看。
方案拆解：够得着靠人定。
安全陪护：险情靠人护。
情绪支持：鼓励靠人给。
跨专业协同：节奏靠人排。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的人际区——示范与记录被工具辅助，但评估陪护仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着风险小：被替代的是「标准动作示范」，不是「个别化陪护」的岗位。有爱心、懂康复、能一对一的老师，需求反而随融合教育上升。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 体育/特教打底，在校多学康复与辅具。AI 时代纯示范在缩，早点练评估。
从「带操」升级成「做评估 + 写方案」，学康复知识，争取当资源老师。
突出个别化案例，写清跟过哪些障碍类型。学校看重稳和爱。
选人别只看体育强，要看有没有共情。能陪护的资源老师，值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 融合教育推，需求缓升。
视频与记录工具提效。
跨教育康复的复合老师更缺。

body: 适应性体育专家为有特殊需要的儿童设计个别化体育方案，改造器材与规则，评估动作与参与能力，在安全和支持中提升体能与自信，是特教体系里的运动支持角色。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 视频能示范标准动作，但哪个孩子今天状态行不行、怎么拆步才够得着，还是老师的眼和心定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Self-checkout scans for you, phones handle payment, and cashierless stores remove the register entirely. Machines are surrounding cashier roles, but people still provide the feeling of being served.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 3,157,200 Cashiers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 2,843,600 by 2034, a net decrease of about 313,600 jobs, with approximately 542,600 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $31,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and automation affect Cashiers more directly than almost any occupation. Self-checkout, scan-and-go shopping, cashierless convenience stores, and AI payment systems are taking over transactions at scale, steadily reducing pure cashier roles. Remaining Cashiers are becoming multi-skilled service workers who manage self-checkout equipment, handle returns, provide membership services, and stock shelves. Machines take over scanning and payment, but not customer service.
ai_s2_accel: Expansion of cashierless checkout across retail scenarios
Adoption of RFID checkout without individual scanning
Automatic checkout through smart shopping carts
ai_s2_auto: Self-service payment in cashierless convenience stores
ai_s3_list: Human customer service: give directions, answer questions, and offer assistance
Returns and dispute handling: balance policy with human circumstances
Response to exceptions: stabilize the site when equipment fails or lines grow
Role flexibility: cover stocking, customer service, and inventory beyond checkout
Loss prevention and cash awareness: detect counterfeit money, missed scans, and account errors
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this role in the moderate AI exposure tier. AI and self-service equipment are taking over scanning, payment, and change-making at scale.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Substantial exposure corresponds to genuine job-contraction risk. Pure cashier roles are declining, but stores will remain. Cashiers who manage self-service equipment, serve customers, and cover multiple functions can transition into store service roles. Workers limited to scanning and payment face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Do not treat this as a long-term career plan. It can work as a temporary or part-time job while you build skills in customer service, operations, or retail management.

Learn self-checkout maintenance, membership operations, and store management, then apply for stocking, customer service, or shift-lead roles. Upgrade from Cashier to multi-skilled store employee to withstand role contraction.
Retail can provide transitional employment while you learn work beyond checkout. On a resume, describe self-service equipment skills, customer services performed, and other roles covered.
Instead of simply reducing Cashiers, redesign the job as a store service specialist who serves customers, manages equipment, and covers multiple functions. Training improves retention.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Purchase by scanning with a phone
Recognize an entire bag without individual scans

ai_s7_trends: Self-checkout and cashierless retail are expanding, steadily reducing pure cashier roles and shifting Cashiers into multi-skilled store service positions.
Mature RFID and AI visual checkout improve transaction efficiency, moving human Cashiers toward exception handling and customer service.
Retail operations are becoming digital, increasing demand for staff who maintain self-service equipment, manage memberships, and cover multiple roles.

body: Cashiers scan merchandise and process cash and mobile payments in retail and service stores. They make change, issue receipts, handle returns, and perform some customer-service and counter-operations work, making them one of the closest points of contact with retail customers.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Self-checkout scans for you, phones handle payment, and cashierless stores remove the register entirely. Machines are surrounding cashier roles, but people still provide the feeling of being served.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自助机替你扫码、手机替你付款，无人店连收银台都省了——收银岗正在被机器围剿，但顾客要的「被服务感」，还得靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年收银员在岗约 315.72 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 284.36 万人，岗位净减约 31.36 万个，年均产生约 54.26 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.12 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和自动化对收银员的冲击，是全行业最直接的。自助收银机、扫码购、无人便利店和 AI 结算正在大规模接管收银环节，纯收银岗位持续收缩。留下来的收银员，正在变成「多技能服务岗」：管自助设备、处理退货、做会员服务、补货理货。机器抢走的是「扫码收钱」，抢不走的是「服务顾客」。
ai_s2_accel: AI 门店运营管理系统
ai_s2_auto: 手机扫码购与刷脸支付
AI 称重与视觉识别结算
ai_s3_list: 顾客服务的温度：问路、答疑、帮忙，机器给不了。
退换货与纠纷处理：人情与规则之间拿捏分寸。
异常情况的应变：设备坏了、排队长了，现场稳住。
多岗位的灵活：收银之外能顶理货、客服、盘点。
防损与现金敏感：假币、漏扫、错账，心里有数。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明收银员的结算环节正被 AI 和自助设备大规模接管——扫码、收银、找零，机器都能完成。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高分曝光对应的是真实的岗位收缩风险。纯收银岗确实在减少，但门店不会消失——会管自助设备、能做服务、能顶多岗的收银员，会转岗为「门店服务专员」活下来；只做扫码收钱的，最危险。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不建议作为长期职业规划。作为过渡或兼职可以，同时往客服、运营、零售管理等方向积累技能。
主动学自助收银维护、会员运营和门店管理，申请转岗理货、客服或领班。从「收银员」升级为「多技能门店员工」，才扛得住岗位收缩。
可先进零售门店过渡，同时学收银之外的本事。简历上多写「会不会自助设备、做过哪些服务、有没有顶过别的岗位」。
与其减少收银员，不如把岗位升级为「门店服务专员」：能服务、能管设备、能顶多岗。给培训，留人更稳。

ai_s7_trends: 自助收银与无人零售全面扩张，纯收银岗持续收缩，收银员向「门店服务专员」多技能岗位转型。
RFID 与 AI 视觉结算技术成熟，结算效率提升，人工收银逐步转为异常处理与客户服务。
零售门店运营数字化，会自助设备维护、会员运营、能顶多岗的员工更抢手。

body: 收银员在零售与服务门店负责商品扫码结算、现金与移动支付收付、找零开票与退货处理，并承担部分顾客服务与柜台运营工作，是零售链条中最贴近顾客的岗位之一。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自助机替你扫码、手机替你付款，无人店连收银台都省了——收银岗正在被机器围剿，但顾客要的「被服务感」，还得靠人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate slides and reviews, but when a student gets stuck on coordination chemistry, the teacher still has to step down and see why.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 25,400 Chemistry Teachers, Postsecondary were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 26,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 600 jobs, with about 1,900 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $86,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Chemistry Teachers, Postsecondary, but it will take over teaching preparation. Automated grading, literature reviews, and slide creation shift teachers' time from making materials to guiding classes, supervising labs, and making research judgments. The real pressure falls on those who only read from the textbook; teachers who can guide students and conduct research are more secure.
ai_s3_list: Classroom guidance: people judge whether students truly understand.
Lab supervision: people teach hands-on procedures.
Research judgment: people set the direction.
Academic guidance: people support student growth.
Accountability: educators remain responsible in practice.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range. Teaching preparation is accelerating significantly, but classroom guidance and research still rely mainly on people, so the occupation remains broadly stable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk: preparation is being accelerated, not the occupation itself. Teachers who guide students and conduct research are more secure, while generative tools will take over more work from those who only read from prepared material.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a strong chemistry foundation and practice communication and research while in school. Routine preparation is shrinking in the AI era, so develop classroom guidance and lab supervision early instead of just reading slides.
Move from making materials to guiding students and conducting research. Use AI to improve efficiency, then work toward leading projects and setting research directions.
Highlight teaching and supervision experience, and specify which labs you have led. Publications should take priority when available.
Do not hire on credentials alone; assess classroom guidance and research ability. Teachers who spark understanding in students deserve stronger compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Generative tools are entering classrooms and speeding up preparation.
Classroom guidance and lab supervision are becoming core skills.
Teachers with research ability are more secure.

body: Chemistry Teachers, Postsecondary teach chemistry courses at colleges and universities, design laboratory work and assessments, supervise theses and research training, and maintain their own teaching and research output. They combine teaching and research roles within chemistry higher education.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate slides and reviews, but when a student gets stuck on coordination chemistry, the teacher still has to step down and see why.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能生成课件和综述，但那学生为啥卡在配位，还得老师下讲台看。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校化学教师在岗约 2.54 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.60 万人，净增约 0.06 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.19 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.62 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校化学教师，但会接手教学准备。批改、综述与课件把常规备课自动化，教师的时间从「做材料」挪向「课堂引导、实验指导与科研判断」。真正被挤掉的是只照本宣科的人，能引导能科研的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 课堂引导：懂没懂靠人察。
实验指导：操作靠人带。
科研判断：方向靠人定。
学业引导：成长靠人对。
责任归属：育人现场担责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中等偏上 AI 曝光区——教学准备被明显加速，但引导与科研仍主要靠人，岗位整体稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被加速的是「备课」，不是「岗位」。会引导、能做科研的人更稳，只照本宣科的人会被生成式工具接走。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 化学打底，在校多练表达与科研。AI 时代纯备课在缩，早点练引导和带实验，别只念 PPT。
从「做材料」升级成「引导 + 科研」，学用 AI 提效，争取拿项目带方向。
突出授课与指导经历，写清带过哪些实验。有论文优先。
招人别只看学历，要看引导和科研力。能点亮学生的老师值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 生成式工具进课堂，备课提速。
课堂引导与实验指导成核心能力。
能科研的人更稳。

body: 高校化学教师在高等院校讲授化学课程，设计实验与考核，指导毕业论文与科研训练，并维持自身的教学与科研产出，是高等教育中化学学科的教学与研究角色。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能生成课件和综述，但那学生为啥卡在配位，还得老师下讲台看。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can answer a standard letter instantly, but people still decide where it should go and how to respond without creating problems.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 6,900 Correspondence Clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 6,500 by 2034, a net loss of about 400 jobs, with about 700 openings annually. The median annual wage was about $46,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will directly reduce the number of Correspondence Clerks, not merely disrupt their work. Template responses, letter classification, and delivery tracking can all be automated. Clerks who exercise judgment, coordinate teams, and cover multiple functions will remain. AI drafts; people review wording and handle complex situations.
ai_s2_accel: Email semantic analysis to assist judgment
ai_s2_auto: Automated bulk email and delivery tracking
ai_s3_list: Classification judgment: determine ownership and action for ambiguous letters.
Wording judgment: maintain appropriate tone and restraint in formal correspondence.
Coordination: follow up across departments and connect handoffs.
Records management: build a searchable archive system.
Exception handling: manage returned mail, complaints, and special correspondence.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure for this office occupation. Nearly all standardized correspondence processing can be automated, reducing job counts. Classification judgment, wording review, and cross-department coordination remain human work, so fewer roles carry greater complexity.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure means broadening your role. Correspondence-only positions offer less room, so add administrative, customer-service, records, and data-analysis skills to offset job contraction.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Do not treat clerk work as a long-term destination; it is an entry step. Build writing and office-software skills, then add basic data analysis and administrative or legal knowledge. Move from clerk roles toward specialist or supervisor positions quickly.

Broaden the job by covering customer service, records, and meeting support. Learn office automation and data organization, then pursue administrative specialist or customer-service supervisor roles. Basic typing and replies are already heavily automated.

Do not describe your experience only as handling letters. Highlight broader administrative work and projects, such as coordinating meetings or digitizing records. Develop strong Excel and document-collaboration skills to advance beyond clerk work.

Combine correspondence-only roles with broader administrative or customer-service positions so one person covers correspondence, records, and customer service. Clear internal transfer paths cost less than frequent replacement hiring.

ai_s7_trends: Correspondence-only roles continue to shrink and merge into broader administrative positions.
AI drafting and automated routing are becoming common, leaving people responsible for review.
Clerks with data and compliance skills are more valuable within administrative teams.

body: Correspondence Clerks process internal and external correspondence. They receive, classify, and register letters; draft and send replies; track email and tickets; archive records; and assist with scheduling as entry-level document coordinators in administrative offices.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can answer a standard letter instantly, but people still decide where it should go and how to respond without creating problems.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能秒回一封标准信函，但「这封信该转给谁、该怎么回才不惹麻烦」，还是得人拿主意。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年通信文员在岗约 0.69 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.65 万人，岗位净减约 0.04 万个，年均产生约 0.07 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.67 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会只冲击通信文员，而是直接压缩这个岗位的数量：模板回复、信件分类、寄发跟踪都能自动化。活下来的是「能判断、会协调、兼多职」的文员——AI 写初稿，人把关措辞和处理复杂情形。
ai_s2_accel: AI 起草初稿人工润色
邮件语义分析辅助判断
行政日程 AI 助理
ai_s2_auto: 信件分类与 OCR 识别
邮件群发与寄发跟踪自动化
ai_s3_list: 分类判断：含糊信件该归谁、怎么办。
措辞把握：正式函件的分寸与语气。
协调沟通：跨部门催办与衔接。
档案管理：建立可检索的归档体系。
异常处理：退信、投诉、特殊函件处置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明通信文员是「中高曝光」的办公文职：标准化信函处理几乎都能自动化，岗位数量在收缩，但分类判断、措辞把关、跨部门协调仍需人，属于「存量在缩、难度在升」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光提醒你要「兼职能」：单做通信文员空间越来越小，往行政、客服、档案、数据分析方向叠加技能，才能对冲岗位收缩。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不建议把「文员」当长期目标：这是入门台阶不是终点。建议孩子练好文字功底和办公软件，再学点数据分析、行政法务常识，从文员岗起步后尽快往专员/主管方向发展。
主动把岗位做「厚」：兼客服、档案、会务，学办公自动化和数据整理，争取转行政专员或客服主管。别再满足于「打字回信」，AI 已把这块吃得差不多了。
求职时别只写「处理信件」，突出综合行政能力和项目案例（组织过会务、做过档案数字化都算）；同时把 Excel、文档协作工具练熟，这是从文员往上走的硬技能。
纯通信文员岗建议合并进行政/客服综合岗，一个人干「文员+档案+客服」的活；给员工明确转岗通道，比频繁招新人更划算。

ai_s7_trends: 纯通信文员岗位持续收缩，职能向行政复合岗合并。
AI 起草与自动化分派普及，人负责把关。
会数据、懂合规的文员在行政体系中更受用。

body: 通信文员负责单位内外往来信函的处理，包括信件接收与分类登记、回复起草与寄发、邮件与工单跟踪、档案归档及日程安排，是行政办公体系中的基础文书协调岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能秒回一封标准信函，但「这封信该转给谁、该怎么回才不惹麻烦」，还是得人拿主意。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can produce a full draft in one pass, but editors still decide whether it should be published and whether its viewpoint is biased.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 115,800 Editors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 116,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 700 jobs, with about 9,800 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $75,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace editors, but it will reshape desk work. Once AI handles first drafts, proofreading, and material organization, editors can shift from polishing sentences to choosing topics, setting tone, and protecting factual accuracy and compliance. Sound judgment and accountability for published content are the truly scarce skills.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent discovery of trends and story ideas
ai_s2_auto: Intelligent generation of first drafts and outlines
Automated proofreading for typos and grammatical problems
Automated collection of source materials and references
Batch suggestions for headlines and summaries
ai_s3_list: Topic selection: people decide what is worth pursuing.
Tone: people determine style and editorial position.
Fact control: experience determines whether sources are credible.
Author relations: people manage trust and tradeoffs.
Accountability: people answer for published content.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high AI exposure range for manuscript processing. AI accelerates generation and proofreading, while people retain editorial judgment and quality control.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces sentence polishing and routine error correction, not editorial direction. Editors who exercise judgment and control tone become scarcer. Junior editors limited to mechanical polishing face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in language, journalism, or a related field. Write and submit work while in school, and practice fact-checking. In the AI era, judgment and tone matter more than routine polishing.
Expand from manuscript editing into topic selection and coordination. Learn compliance and data analysis, master AI generation tools, and develop into an editor who can own a section.
Highlight the topics you have managed, serious errors you have caught, and editorial tones you have maintained. Experience in a specialized field is an advantage.
Assess judgment and quality control, not only proofreading accuracy. Editors who can take ownership of a section merit premium compensation.

ai_s7_trends: AI generation has created a severe oversupply of basic copy.
Editors who exercise judgment and control tone are becoming scarcer.
Compliance and fact-checking are becoming core defenses.

body: Editors plan and approve content topics, commission and organize manuscripts, and review wording, structure, facts, and compliance. They coordinate pages or sections and are responsible for accuracy, readability, and editorial tone.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can produce a full draft in one pass, but editors still decide whether it should be published and whether its viewpoint is biased.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一气呵成初稿，但「这篇该不该发、立场偏没偏」，还得编辑拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年编辑在岗约 11.58 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 11.65 万人，净增约 0.07 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.98 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.53 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代编辑，但会重做案头工作。初稿生成、错别字校对、素材整理交给 AI 后，编辑从「改字句」挪向「定选题、把调性、守事实与合规」。真正稀缺的是有判断、能担内容责任的人。
ai_s2_accel: 热点与选题的智能发现
多版本改写的快速迭代
ai_s2_auto: 初稿与提纲的智能生成
错别字与语病的自动校对
素材与资料的自动归集
标题与摘要的批量建议
ai_s3_list: 选题判断：什么值得做靠人定。
调性把握：风格与立场靠人。
事实把关：信源真伪靠经验。
作者沟通：默契与取舍靠人。
责任兜底：发出去要人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的文稿处理区——生成和校对能被加速，但判断和把关仍留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「改字句和校错」，不是「定方向」。会做判断、把调性的人更稀缺。怕的是只会机械润色的初级编。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 中文/新闻打底，在校多写多投、练事实核查。AI 时代拼的是判断和调性，别只当润色员。
从改稿扩到选题和统筹，学合规与数据，把 AI 生成工具用熟，升级成能担栏目的责任编辑。
突出你跟过什么选题、纠过什么硬伤、管过什么调性。有垂直领域经验优先。
招人看判断和把关力，不止看错别字改得准。能担栏目的编辑值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: AI 生成让基础文稿产能严重过剩。
会判断和把调性的编辑更稀缺。
合规与事实核查成核心壁垒。

body: 编辑（Editors）策划与审定内容选题，组织稿件并对文字、结构、事实与合规进行加工把关，统筹版面或栏目，对内容的准确性、可读性与调性负责。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能一气呵成初稿，但「这篇该不该发、立场偏没偏」，还得编辑拍板。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Smart smoke detectors and building models can assist, but Fire Inspectors And Investigators still make on-site judgments and official determinations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Fire Inspectors And Investigators is projected to rise from about 14,700 in 2024 to 15,200 in 2034. That is a net increase of about 500 jobs, with roughly 1,500 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $78,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Fire Inspectors And Investigators, but it will reduce routine inspections. IoT smoke detectors and BIM models accelerate standard checks. Inspectors are shifting from checklist work to hazard determination, fire-cause investigation, responsibility findings, and remediation oversight. Checklist-only roles face the most pressure. Strong investigators become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: On-site judgment: people identify hazards.
Fire-cause investigation: people find the truth.
Responsibility findings: people evaluate evidence.
Remediation oversight: people ensure action.
Safety training: people explain requirements.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this career in the low-moderate exposure range for field inspection. Systems accelerate routine inspections, while people still make determinations and assign responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high career risk. Automation replaces checklist work, not fire prevention and accountability. Investigators who make defensible determinations become scarcer as productivity rises. Inspectors limited to form-based checks face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build knowledge of fire safety and law-enforcement fieldwork, with strong command of standards. Routine inspection is shrinking in the AI era, so practice investigation early.
Move from checklist work to investigation and official determinations. Learn fire-cause analysis.
Highlight credentials and field experience. State which building types you have inspected.
Do not hire based only on physical endurance. Look for sound judgment. Experienced investigators who make determinations merit strong compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Smart monitoring shifts routine inspection away from field staff.
Fire-cause investigation creates opportunities.
Inspectors with investigative ability are in greater demand.

body: Fire Inspectors And Investigators enforce fire-prevention standards, identify hazards, and investigate fire causes. They use site examination and evidence collection to issue remediation requirements and official findings.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Smart smoke detectors and building models can assist, but Fire Inspectors And Investigators still make on-site judgments and official determinations.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 智能烟感和建模能辅助，但现场判断与认定还是检查员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年消防检查员调查员在岗约 1.47 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.52 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.15 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.81 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代消防检查员调查员，但会压缩常规巡检。物联网烟感与 BIM 建模把标准排查提速，检查员从「跑清单」挪向「隐患判定、火因调查、责任认定、整改督导」。真正被挤掉的是只做表格式巡检的，有调查力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场判断：隐患靠人看。
火因调查：真相靠人找。
责任认定：证据靠人判。
整改督导：落地靠人盯。
安全培训：讲清靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的现场区——常规巡检被系统加速，但判定与认定还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「跑清单」动作，不是「防火追责」的岗位。有调查力、能认定的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会做表格式巡检的检查员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 消防警界起步多练规范与现场，AI 时代纯巡检在缩，早点练调查。
从「跑清单」升级成「调查 + 认定」，学火因分析。
突出资质与现场，写清跟过哪些建筑。
选人别只看体力，要看有没有判断脑子。能认定的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 智能监测外移巡检。
火因调查带来机会。
有调查力的检查员更抢手。

body: 消防检查员与调查员执行防火规范检查、排查火灾隐患并调查起火原因，运用现场勘察与证据采集做出整改与认定结论。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 智能烟感和建模能辅助，但现场判断与认定还是检查员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automatic polishing machines handle standard items, while workers still use tactile judgment to choose abrasive fineness and finish unusual curves.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 11,800 workers in 2024, projected to decline to 9,300 by 2034. That is a net decrease of about 2,500 jobs, with roughly 800 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $41,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Grinding and Polishing Workers, but it will absorb routine products. Automated and CNC polishing accelerates standard work, shifting workers from high-volume grinding toward custom finishing, tactile quality control, and equipment maintenance. People limited to standard items face displacement, while skilled finishers become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Tactile control: people regulate force.
Custom finishing: people shape curves.
Appearance judgment: people inspect reflections.
Anomaly handling: people resolve sticking points.
Experience transfer: people teach craft knowledge.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation in a low-moderate AI exposure range. Automation absorbs standard items, while people remain necessary for custom finishing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still changes the work. AI replaces batch grinding of standard items, not custom finishing. Workers with strong tactile control and quality skills become scarcer as automation spreads. People limited to standard items face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build vocational foundations and practice tactile control and self-inspection. Standard-item work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop finishing skills early.
Progress from volume grinding to finishing and quality control, and learn equipment and visual inspection.
Emphasize tactile examples and experience with different part shapes and materials.
Do not evaluate candidates only by speed. Assess tactile control and self-inspection, and pay a higher piece rate for skilled finishers.

ai_s7_trends: CNC polishing is spreading, reducing standard-item work.
Visual inspection replaces some manual checks.
Workers with strong tactile control and finishing skills are in greater demand.

body: Grinding and Polishing Workers, Hand use handheld tools, grinding wheels, and polishing wheels to grind, deburr, and polish workpieces. They control force and angle to meet surface-finish and dimensional requirements as skilled finishers in manufacturing.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automatic polishing machines handle standard items, while workers still use tactile judgment to choose abrasive fineness and finish unusual curves.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动抛光机能跑标准件，但那件异形弧度、该用多细的砂，还是工人凭手感定的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工人、手工在岗约 1.18 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.93 万人，岗位净减约 0.25 万个，年均产生约 0.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.17 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代研磨工，但会吃常规件。自动与数控抛光把标准件提速，工人从「磨大批量」挪向「异形精修 + 手感质控 + 设备运维」。真正被挤掉的是只磨标准件的人，手感好能精修的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 手感控制：力度靠人控。
异形精修：弧度靠人磨。
外观判断：反光靠人看。
异常处理：卡点靠人处。
经验传承：诀窍靠人带。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的精修区——标准件被自动吃，异形精修还留人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：被替代的是「标准件批量研磨」动作，不是「异形精修」的岗位。手感好、能质控的人反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只会磨标准件的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职校打底，多练手感和自检。AI 时代标准件在缩，早点练精修。
从「磨批量」升级成「精修 + 质控」，学设备和视觉检。
突出手感案例和件型经验，写清跟过哪些材料。
选人别只看快，看手感和自检。能精修的工人值得给高计件。

ai_s7_trends: 数控抛光普及，标准件缩。
视觉检替部分目检。
手感好能精修的工人更抢手。

body: 手工研磨与抛光工人用手持工具与砂轮抛光轮对工件研磨去刺抛光，控制力度角度使表面光洁尺寸达标，是制造链的表面精修手艺人。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动抛光机能跑标准件，但那件异形弧度、该用多细的砂，还是工人凭手感定的。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate working hours and line balance into simulations, but "why is this station always stuck?" someone still has to go to the production line to see.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be about 74,600 industrial engineering technicians and technicians on the job in 2024, and it is expected to rise to 75,900 by 2034, with a net increase of about 1,300 jobs, an average annual vacancy of about 6,300, and a median annual salary of about $64,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI won’t replace industrial engineering technicians, but it will speed up analysis. After data collection, line balance simulation and reports are handed over to AI, technicians move from "calculating data" to "making on-site improvements and engaging in human-machine coordination." What is really scarce are people who can work on the production line and implement plans.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted identification of production line bottlenecks
Intelligent early warning for abnormal working hours
ai_s2_auto: Automatic collection of working hours and action data
Simulation optimization of line balance and production capacity
Automatic reporting of yield and cycle time
Automatic generation of standard work documents
ai_s3_list: On-site improvement: Squatting on the production line to find real problems.
Human-machine coordination: How to match people and equipment.
Implementation promotion: let the team really implement it.
Method judgment: Which research is more appropriate.
Stakeholder communication: cross-functional alignment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 shows that this profession is in the industrial data area with medium and high exposure - collection, simulation, and reporting can all be accelerated, but on-site improvement is still left to people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But medium and high exposure does not mean high risk: what is replaced is "calculation and reporting", not "implementation". Technicians who can work on the production line and promote improvements are even rarer. What I'm afraid of are junior positions that only do calculations and records.

ai_s5_persona.建议: I have a solid foundation in industrial engineering and am studying data analysis and MES in school. In the AI ​​era, fight for implementation on the spot, don’t just be a recordkeeper.
Be familiar with simulation and digital twins to supplement on-site driving force. Upgraded from "measurement of work hours" to "management improvement" and transferred to IE engineer.
Highlight what improvements you have made and how much efficiency you have improved. Production line and MES experience is preferred.
Recruitment depends on on-site promotion and data analysis, not just certificates. Skilled technicians deserve high salaries.

ai_s7_trends: Smart manufacturing drives demand for continuous improvement.
Digital twins and MES are popularized, and analysis positions are compressed.
Composite technicians who know on-site implementation and data analysis are more stable.

body: Industrial engineering technicians and technicians use method research, work measurement and line balancing to optimize processes, layouts, working hours standards and production capacity at manufacturing and service sites, and implement industrial engineers' plans on the production line.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate working hours and line balance into simulations, but "why is this station always stuck?" someone still has to go to the production line to see.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把工时和线平衡算成仿真，但「这个工位为什么总卡」，还得人去产线看。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代工业工程技师，但会加速分析。数据采集、线平衡仿真和报表交给 AI 后，技师从「算数据」挪向「做现场改善、搞人机协调」。真正稀缺的是能蹲产线、把方案钉落地的人。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助识别产线瓶颈
数字孪生辅助验证改善
ai_s2_auto: 工时与动作数据的自动采集
线平衡与产能的仿真优化
良率与节拍的自动报表
标准作业文档的自动生成
ai_s3_list: 现场改善：蹲产线找真问题。
人机协调：人和设备怎么配。
落地推动：让班组真执行。
方法判断：哪种研究更对路。
stakeholder 沟通：跨岗对齐。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的工业数据区——采集、仿真、报表都能被加速，但现场改善仍留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「算和报」，不是「落地」。会蹲产线、能推动改善的技师更稀缺。怕的是只做测算记录的初级岗。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 工业工程打底，在校多学数据分析与 MES。AI 时代拼现场落地，别只当记录员。
把仿真和数字孪生用熟，补现场推动力。从「测工时」升级成「管改善」，转 IE 工程师。
突出你做过什么改善、提了多少效率。有产线和 MES 经验优先。
招人看现场推动和数据分析，不止看证书。能落地的技师值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 智能制造拉动持续改善需求。
数字孪生与 MES 普及，分析岗压缩。
会现场落地与数据分析的复合技师更稳。

body: 工业工程技师与技术员运用方法研究、作业测定与线平衡，在制造和服务现场优化流程、布局、工时标准与产能，把工业工程师的方案落到产线上。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把工时和线平衡算成仿真，但「这个工位为什么总卡」，还得人去产线看。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can identify a compatible model in one second, but your experience is still needed to uncover the problem hidden in a customer's comment about squealing brakes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 272,100 sales workers were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 280,600, a net increase of about 8,500 jobs, with about 30,200 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $37,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace auto parts salespersons, but it will change how they work. Systems and AI are taking over catalog searches, inventory checks, quotes, and order entry, shifting salespeople from parts lookup clerks to needs consultants + customer relationship operators. Machines cannot replace fault assessment, fit verification, or trust building. Salespeople who know vehicle models and provide strong service become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI parts recommendations based on fault descriptions
Automatic vehicle-information matching through license plate recognition
E-commerce price comparisons pushing stores to upgrade service
Automatic customer follow-up through customer management systems
ai_s2_auto: Automatic searches of parts catalogs and fitment data
Inventory checks and automatic replenishment reminders
Digital quotes, order entry, and payment collection
Automatic generation of sales records and customer ledgers
ai_s3_list: Needs assessment: determining actual needs from fault symptoms and vehicle use.
Fitment judgment: experience resolves compatibility beyond catalogs and differences between model-year updates.
Trust and relationships: repeat customers recognize people, and communication resolves repair disputes.
On-site response: calmly managing line-cutting, rush orders, and stockouts at the counter.
Professional knowledge: continuously learning as vehicle models change.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates that half of the role's desk tasks are being automated. AI and systems can search catalogs, check inventory, and enter orders.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI takes over searches, leaving needs assessment and service to people. Listening, verifying fit, and maintaining customers become more important. Pure order-entry roles are being reduced, while salespeople who understand vehicle models and provide service become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: People interested in cars can study automotive repair or automotive marketing and work during breaks at 4S dealerships or auto parts markets. Develop both vehicle-model knowledge and customer communication instead of learning only order entry.

Master system tools and customer management, actively learn about new-energy vehicles and electronic components, and earn automotive repair skills credentials. Advance from order-entry clerk to needs consultant + customer relationship operator.

An automotive repair or vehicle background is ideal, but people without one can begin as parts apprentices or inventory clerks. On your resume, specify the vehicle parts you know, how many customers you have served, and which difficult needs you have resolved.

Do not hire salespeople based on experience alone. Assess learning ability and service orientation. Candidates who listen to needs, verify fit, and turn customers into repeat buyers offer the rarest combination.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Search models by vehicle and year

ai_s7_trends: As AI search and recommendations spread, salespeople are shifting from parts lookup and order entry to needs consulting + customer relationship operations, with vehicle expertise becoming the core barrier to entry.
As new-energy vehicle ownership rises, demand grows for high-voltage components, electronics, and smart parts, making salespeople familiar with new technologies more valuable.
As e-commerce and chain channels expand, store salespeople are becoming hybrid professionals who combine in-person experience + online fulfillment.

body: Auto parts salespersons sell automotive parts and provide related services. They receive customers, confirm vehicle and fault needs, search catalogs and verify fit, quote and enter orders, prepare and ship goods, and manage inventory, ensuring the right parts reach customers.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can identify a compatible model in one second, but your experience is still needed to uncover the problem hidden in a customer's comment about squealing brakes.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一秒查出适配型号，但客户一句「刹车异响」里藏的问题，还得靠你的经验去问出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年销售艺术在岗约 27.21 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 28.06 万人，净增约 0.85 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.02 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.74 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代汽配销售员，但会改变工作方式。目录检索、库存查询、报价开单正被系统和 AI 接管，销售从「查件员」转向「需求顾问+客户运营」——判断故障、核适配、维护信任，是机器替代不了的。懂车型又会做服务的销售反而更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 根据故障描述推荐配件
车牌识别车辆信息自动适配
电商平台比价倒逼门店服务升级
客户管理系统自动跟进回访
ai_s2_auto: 配件目录与适配查询自动检索
库存查询与自动补货提醒
报价开单与收款电子化
销售记录与客户台账自动生成
ai_s3_list: 需求甄别：从故障现象与用车情况判断真实需求。
适配判断：目录之外的兼容性、年份改款差异靠经验。
信任与关系：老客户认人，维修纠纷靠沟通化解。
现场应变：柜台前的插队、急单、缺货都能稳住。
专业积累：车型换代知识更新，持续学习的劲头。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半桌面任务正被自动化——查目录、查库存、开单，AI 和系统都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接管的是「查询」环节，留下的是「需求判断与服务」环节——听需求、核适配、维护客户反而更重要。真正被压缩的是纯开单型岗位，懂车型、会做服务的销售更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 喜欢车可以选汽修、汽车营销相关专业，假期去 4S 店和汽配城打工。把车型知识和客户沟通都练起来，别只学开单。
把系统工具和客户管理用熟，主动学新能源车型与电子件知识，考汽修技能证书。从「开单员」升级为「需求顾问+客户运营」。
有汽修或车辆背景最好，无背景可从配件学徒或库管做起。简历上多写「熟悉哪些车型配件、服务过多少客户、处理过哪些疑难需求」。
招销售别只看经验，要看学习能力和服务意识。能听需求、能核适配、又能把客户处成回头客的候选人，是最稀缺的组合。

ai_s7_trends: AI 检索与推荐普及，销售从「查件开单」转向「需求顾问+客户运营」，车型专业能力成为核心壁垒。
新能源车保有量上升，高压件、电子件与智能配件需求增长，懂新技术的销售更抢手。
电商与连锁化渠道扩张，门店销售向「线下体验+线上履约」复合角色转变。

body: 汽配销售员负责汽车配件的销售与配套服务，包括接待客户、确认车型与故障需求、查询目录核对适配、报价开单、备货发货与库存管理，是把配件准确送到客户手里的关键岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能一秒查出适配型号，但客户一句「刹车异响」里藏的问题，还得靠你的经验去问出来。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can help review literature and code data, but sociologists still decide which questions matter, how to interpret conclusions, and what position to take.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 3,400 sociologists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 3,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 200 jobs, with about 300 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $101,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace sociologists, but it will accelerate data processing. Text mining, automated coding, and literature reviews speed up repetitive work, shifting sociologists from reading literature and coding data toward research design, theoretical insight, value judgments, and policy communication. Assistants who only clean data face displacement, while people with strong theoretical and interpretive abilities become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Large language models assisting with scale design
ai_s3_list: Research design: people define the questions.
Theoretical insight: people develop explanations.
Value judgments: people determine the position.
Policy communication: people put findings into practice.
Field understanding: people grasp the context.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in a moderately high exposure research category. Systems accelerate literature review and coding, but people retain an essential role in design and interpretation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is data cleaning and coding, not theoretical research roles. People with strong theoretical abilities who can explain society become scarcer as productivity rises. Assistants who only clean data face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with a bachelor's degree in sociology and study methods and statistics extensively while in school. Pure data-cleaning work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop theory and writing skills early.
Advance from working with data to framing questions plus building theory. Learn text-mining tools and seek opportunities to lead research projects.
Highlight field research and writing experience and clearly describe the types of studies you have conducted. Think tanks value interpretive ability.
When hiring, look beyond methodological proficiency and assess whether candidates can identify important questions. Core contributors who can explain society are worth a permanent position.

ai_s7_trends: Text mining raises productivity and reduces cleaning work.
Think tanks and policy research create opportunities.
People with strong theoretical and interpretive abilities are in greater demand.

body: Sociologists lead research on social structures, behavior, and change. They integrate theory, methods, and data, use surveys and qualitative approaches, and produce academic or policy research that influences public decisions.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can help review literature and code data, but sociologists still decide which questions matter, how to interpret conclusions, and what position to take.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮着读文献和做编码，但哪个问题值得问、结论怎么解释、立场怎么摆，还是社会学家定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年社会学家在岗约 0.34 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.36 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.03 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.17 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代社会学家，但会加速数据处理。文本挖掘、自动编码与文献综述把重复工作提速，社会学家从「读文献做编码」挪向「研究设计、理论洞察、价值判断、政策沟通」。真正被挤掉的是只做数据清洗的助理，有理论力能解释的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 研究设计：问题靠人定。
理论洞察：解释靠人。
价值判断：立场靠人。
政策沟通：落地靠人。
田野理解：语境靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的研究区——文献与编码被系统加速，但设计与解释还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「数据清洗与编码」动作，不是「理论研究」的岗位。有理论力、能解释社会的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做清洗的助理。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 社会学本科打底，在校多摸方法和统计。AI 时代纯清洗在缩，早点练理论和写作。
从「做数据」升级成「提问题 + 建理论」，学文本挖掘工具，争取拿课题。
突出调研和写作经验，写清做过哪些类型研究。智库看重解释力。
选人别只看方法熟，要看有没有问题脑子。能解释社会的骨干，值得给编制。

ai_s7_trends: 文本挖掘提效，清洗缩。
智库与政策研究带来机会。
有理论解释力的人更抢手。

body: 社会学家主导社会结构、行为与变迁的研究，统筹理论、方法与数据，运用调查与质性手段，产出学术或政策研究并影响公共决策。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮着读文献和做编码，但哪个问题值得问、结论怎么解释、立场怎么摆，还是社会学家定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Screening and follow-up tools can assist, but counselors still determine trust, crisis responses, and treatment plans.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 483,500 substance abuse, behavioral disorder, and mental health counselors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 564,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 81,100 jobs, with about 48,300 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $59,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace these counselors, but it will reduce routine initial screening and follow-up. Assessment apps and digital follow-up move standard screening outside the counseling session, shifting counselors from administering scales toward building trust, intervening in crises, tailoring plans, and providing long-term support. People who only conduct initial screenings face displacement, while those with strong clinical capabilities become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Building trust: people receive and hold another person's pain.
Crisis intervention: people make life-critical judgments.
Tailoring plans: different people require different methods.
Long-term support: people accompany the process of change.
Maintaining boundaries: people safeguard safety.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in a moderately AI-exposed area of helping work. Systems accelerate initial screening, but people retain an essential role in trust and crisis response.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is administering scales, not psychological recovery work. People with strong clinical skills who can handle crises become scarcer as productivity rises. Counselors who only conduct initial screening face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin in psychology or social work and develop empathy and professional licensure. Pure initial screening is shrinking in the AI era, so build clinical skills early.
Advance from administering scales to crisis response plus treatment planning, and learn evidence-based techniques.
Highlight case experience and qualifications, clearly describing the areas in which you have worked.
When hiring, look beyond certificates and assess clinical judgment. Core counselors who can handle crises deserve strong compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Digital screening moves initial assessment outside the counseling session.
Crisis response and tailored planning create opportunities.
Counselors with strong clinical skills are in greater demand.

body: These counselors provide assessment, individual and group counseling, and rehabilitation plans for people affected by substance abuse, behavioral disorders, and emotional distress, using evidence-based techniques to support behavioral change.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Screening and follow-up tools can assist, but counselors still determine trust, crisis responses, and treatment plans.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 筛查与随访工具能辅助，但信任、危机与方案还是咨询师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年物质滥用、行为障碍与心理健康咨询师在岗约 48.35 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 56.46 万人，净增约 8.11 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.83 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.92 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类咨询师，但会压缩初筛与随访。量表 App 与数字随访把常规筛查外移，咨询师从「跑量表」挪向「信任建立、危机干预、方案定制、长期陪伴」。真正被挤掉的是只做初筛的，有临床力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 信任建立：痛苦靠人接。
危机干预：性命靠人判。
方案定制：人不同法不同。
长期陪伴：改变靠人陪。
边界把控：安全靠人守。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的助人区——初筛被系统加速，但信任与危机还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「跑量表」动作，不是「心理重建」的岗位。有临床力、能接危机的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会做初筛的咨询师。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 心理社工起步多练共情与执照，AI 时代纯初筛在缩，早点练临床。
从「跑量表」升级成「危机 + 方案」，学循证技术。
突出个案与资质，写清跟过哪些方向。
选人别只看证书，要看有没有临床脑子。能接危机的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 数字筛查外移初筛。
危机与定制带来机会。
有临床力的咨询师更抢手。

body: 这类咨询师为受物质滥用、行为障碍与情绪困扰的人群提供评估、个体与团体咨询及康复计划，运用循证技术推动行为改变。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 筛查与随访工具能辅助，但信任、危机与方案还是咨询师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate wind resources, but managers still decide which land is worth securing, how to turn a proposal into a partnership, and how to negotiate investment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,333,700 wind energy development managers were employed in 2024, with employment projected to rise to 1,393,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 59,800 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 106,700 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $136,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace wind energy development managers, but it will reduce research work. AI and modeling accelerate wind-resource assessment, site selection, and operations forecasting, shifting managers from processing data toward government and corporate coordination, investment judgment, compliance oversight, and long-term relationships. Basic research roles face the greatest pressure, while people who execute projects and deliver results become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Government and corporate coordination: people build the relationships.
Investment judgment: people negotiate the price.
Compliance oversight: people define the boundaries.
Project execution: people drive progress.
Long-term relationships: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 indicates moderate-high exposure in renewable energy. Systems accelerate assessments, but people retain coordination and judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Basic research actions are being replaced, not project execution roles. People who coordinate and deliver projects become scarcer as efficiency improves. Those who only process data face the risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin in engineering or environmental studies and develop policy and commercial skills. Pure research is shrinking in the AI era, so build project execution ability early.
Advance from assessment to approvals and investment negotiation, and learn grid connection and commercial work.
Highlight projects and resources and clearly state the regions you have covered. Investors value steady execution and delivery.
Do not hire solely for education. Assess coordination ability. Core personnel who deliver projects deserve high compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Declining subsidies force grid parity.
Offshore wind is gaining momentum.
Intelligent operations and maintenance are accelerating.

body: Wind energy development managers lead the development and coordination of wind-power projects, assess wind resources and grid conditions, advance approvals and investment, and coordinate stakeholders to move projects from initiation to delivery.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate wind resources, but managers still decide which land is worth securing, how to turn a proposal into a partnership, and how to negotiate investment.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算风资源，但哪块地值得拿、怎么讲成合作、投资怎么谈，还是经理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年风能开发经理在岗约 133.37 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 139.35 万人，净增约 5.98 万个岗位，年均产生约 10.67 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 13.65 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代风能开发经理，但会压缩调研环节。AI 与建模把风资源评估、选址与运维预测提速，经理从「跑数据」挪向「政企协调、投资判断、合规统筹、长期关系」。真正被挤掉的是只做基础调研的，有操盘力能落地的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 政企协调：关系靠人跑。
投资判断：价位靠人谈。
合规统筹：边界靠人定。
项目落地：推动靠人。
长期关系：信任靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的新能源区——评估被系统加速，但协调与判断还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「基础调研」动作，不是「项目操盘」的岗位。有协调力、能落地的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会跑数据的开发。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 工程/环境起步多练政策与商务，AI 时代纯调研在缩，早点练操盘。
从「做评估」升级成「跑审批 + 谈投资」，学并网与商务。
突出项目与资源，写清跟过哪些区域。投资看重稳和落。
选人别只看学历，要看会不会协调。能落地的骨干，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 补贴退坡倒逼平价。
海上风电升温。
运维智能化提速。

body: 风能开发经理主导风电项目的开发统筹，评估风资源与并网条件，推进审批与投资，协调多方推动项目从立项落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能算风资源，但哪块地值得拿、怎么讲成合作、投资怎么谈，还是经理定。
